assembled_assistant_envelope_definition: Canonical UTF-8 JSON over final content, reasoning_content, tool_calls, and finish_reason, with sorted keys and compact separators.
token_id_parity_reason: The frozen streaming harness retained final text, reasoning text, tool calls, usage, finish reason, event digests, and content hashes, but not endpoint-returned output token IDs.
claim_boundary: The equal 24/27 automatic-quality totals do not imply output parity. Only 9/27 assembled assistant envelopes were byte-identical across the separately collected, configuration-matched arms. Exact token-ID parity cannot be claimed because output token IDs were not retained.
